description: This is a C# interface definition file for ITransactionTestGrain, part of the Orleans framework, specifying grain methods for transaction-based operations such as Set, Add, Get, and error-throwing variants, within the Orleans.Transactions.TestKit namespace.

classes.name: ITransactionTestGrain
classes.description: Interface defining transactional grain methods for testing, extending IGrainWithGuidKey.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a new value in the transaction state, marked with transaction attribute.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a number to the transaction state and returns the new state as an array of integers, marked with transaction attribute.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction state as an array of integers, marked with transaction attribute.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a number to the transaction state and throws an exception, used for testing transactional error handling.

methods.name: SetAndThrow
methods.description: Sets a value in the transaction state and throws an exception, used for testing transactional error handling.
